source_rule: Random category; longest WAV; gain 0.05-0.20 rounded to 0.01; equal-duration silence after each segment. High-confidence distressing events are replaced by equal-duration calm segments from the same fixed-track collection.
license_status: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; verified against the public DataSEC v3 record on 2026-07-13
attribution: DataSEC - Dataset for Sound Event Classification of environmental noise, Fredianelli et al., DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17033970. Adapted into fixed experimental stimulus tracks.
provenance_note: The source WAVs were created by the original play_background.py rule. Their per-segment random choices were not logged; reproducibility is therefore guaranteed by the fixed stimulus hashes below, not by reconstructing the random sequence. The distributed v2 tracks preserve the original 2700-second timelines while replacing audited glass-breaking and emergency-siren intervals with already-audited calm ambient intervals.

sanitization.method: High-confidence distressing source-event intervals are replaced by equal-duration calm segments from the existing fixed-track collection with 250 ms boundary fades.
